name: RYTHM Inc.
summary: RYTHM, Inc. is a company that delivers solutions for the cannabis and industrial hemp sectors throughout the United States. Among its offerings are hemp-derived tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) beverages, which it markets to consumers under the Señorita brand. Founded in 2016, the firm's main office is situated in Troy, Michigan. It was previously known as Agrify Corporation until it adopted its current name, RYTHM, Inc., in August 2025.
